description: Final check: what fraction of each kinesin-II subunit is present in PDB 9IKB, element by element, and composition of the unresolved KLP-11 distal tail
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---- 1. Re-download 9IKB and recompute modelled ranges directly (no persistence between calls) ----
raw = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/9IKB.cif", timeout=120).text
cols=[];atoms=[];inl=False
for l in raw.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(l.strip().split(".")[1]); inl=True
    elif inl:
        if l.startswith("#") or l.strip()=="": break
        atoms.append(l.split())
A=pd.DataFrame(atoms,columns=cols)
A["label_seq_id"]=pd.to_numeric(A.label_seq_id,errors="coerce")
off={'B':528,'C':526,'G':124}
A=A[A.auth_asym_id.isin(off)].copy()
A["upos"]=A.label_seq_id+A.auth_asym_id.map(off)
A=A[~((A.auth_asym_id=='B')&(A.upos<537))]          # drop HHHHSQDG tag
modelled={c:(int(g.upos.min()),int(g.upos.max()),int(g.upos.nunique())) for c,g in A.groupby("auth_asym_id")}
print("modelled ranges (UniProt numbering):", modelled)

# ---- 2. Full-length sequences from UniProt ----
def seq(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:])
S={a:seq(a) for a in ["Q19633","Q965T6","G5EEE6"]}
L={k:len(v) for k,v in S.items()}
print("lengths:", L)

# ---- 3. Element-by-element coverage table ----
# element spans from InterPro/Pfam + AlphaFold helix assignment (recorded in provenance/paralog_region_comparison.tsv)
elems = [
 ("KLP-11","Q19633","B","motor domain",11,351),
 ("KLP-11","Q19633","B","neck linker",331,347),
 ("KLP-11","Q19633","B","neck coil",351,405),
 ("KLP-11","Q19633","B","stalk CC1",409,501),
 ("KLP-11","Q19633","B","CC2 / PF32951 trigger",545,592),
 ("KLP-11","Q19633","B","tail, KAP-1 interface",640,722),
 ("KLP-11","Q19633","B","distal tail",723,782),
 ("KLP-20","Q965T6","C","motor domain",5,339),
 ("KLP-20","Q965T6","C","neck linker",319,335),
 ("KLP-20","Q965T6","C","neck coil",339,393),
 ("KLP-20","Q965T6","C","stalk CC1",397,489),
 ("KLP-20","Q965T6","C","CC2 / PF32951 trigger",536,584),
 ("KLP-20","Q965T6","C","tail, KAP-1 interface",585,646),
]
mod_by_chain={c:set(g.upos.astype(int)) for c,g in A.groupby("auth_asym_id")}
rows=[]
for prot,acc,ch,el,s,e in elems:
    span=set(range(s,e+1)); got=len(span & mod_by_chain[ch])
    rows.append(dict(protein=prot,element=el,span=f"{s}-{e}",residues=len(span),
                     modelled_in_9IKB=got,pct_modelled=round(100*got/len(span),1)))
cov=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(cov.to_string(index=False))

tot11=len(mod_by_chain['B']); tot20=len(mod_by_chain['C'])
print(f"\nKLP-11: {tot11}/{L['Q19633']} residues modelled = {100*tot11/L['Q19633']:.1f}%")
print(f"KLP-20: {tot20}/{L['Q965T6']} residues modelled = {100*tot20/L['Q965T6']:.1f}%")
print(f"KAP-1 : {len(mod_by_chain['G'])}/{L['G5EEE6']} = {100*len(mod_by_chain['G'])/L['G5EEE6']:.1f}%")

# ---- 4. Composition of the unresolved KLP-11 distal tail 723-782 ----
tail=S["Q19633"][722:782]; motor=S["Q19633"][10:351]
print("\nKLP-11 723-782:",tail)
from collections import Counter
def frac(s,aas): return 100*sum(s.count(a) for a in aas)/len(s)
for name,aas in [("acidic DE","DE"),("basic KR","KR"),("S/T","ST"),("P","P"),("hydrophobic AVLIMFWY","AVLIMFWY")]:
    print(f"  {name:22s} tail {frac(tail,aas):5.1f}%   motor {frac(motor,aas):5.1f}%")
print("  net charge (K+R)-(D+E):", sum(tail.count(a) for a in "KR")-sum(tail.count(a) for a in "DE"))
# S/T-P (proline-directed phospho) and known short motifs, reported as counts only
import re
print("  S/T-P sites:", [(m.start()+723, tail[m.start():m.start()+2]) for m in re.finditer(r"[ST]P",tail)])

# ---- 5. Figure: coverage of the hypothesis-named elements ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,4.2))
d=cov.copy(); d["lab"]=d.protein+"  "+d.element
y=np.arange(len(d))[::-1]
ax.barh(y,d.pct_modelled,color=["#2b6cb0" if p=="KLP-11" else "#b03060" for p in d.protein],height=.62)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(d.lab,fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("percent of element resolved in PDB 9IKB"); ax.set_xlim(0,105)
for yy,v,n in zip(y,d.pct_modelled,d.residues):
    ax.text(v+1.5,yy,f"{v:.0f}%  ({n} aa)",va="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_title("PDB 9IKB resolves only the CC2 trigger and tail.\nThe neck linker, neck coil and stalk CC1 are absent from both subunits.",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

cov.to_csv("/tmp/cov.tsv",sep="\t",index=False)
print("\nTSV:\n"+open("/tmp/cov.tsv").read())
